body: TermAl lane practice (Fable2, 2026-10-23): after a focused run ends, a lane that wants to act once the host record settles MUST register termal_resume_after_test_runs (the settle wake arrives about 2 min later) or simply proceed in its next turn. Ending the turn and "waiting for the settle" without registering leaves the lane idle indefinitely: BarA2 idled 8 and 29 min, and Sol-edfd 16 min, on 2026-10-23. Coordinator: include this in GOs.
